purpose: Freeze the clean-room NEW Route/Hosted QA implementation after dedicated owner routing, validator admission, deterministic self-test coverage, and candidate Project Check success. Preserve the RH1 read-only HTTP Hosted boundary without reopening semantic, asset, frontend, Browser/UI, deployment-writer, or OLD Project Doctor runtime authority.

implementationEvidence.playwrightAssertionFixMeaning: Allow the frozen contract property reference contract.runtime.playwright while still forbidding Playwright package imports, dynamic imports, and require dependencies in the NEW runtime.

reviews.detail: The OLD strict hosted-proof workflow remains separate predecessor/legacy evidence with a historical deployment-writer role. RH3 neither inherits nor retires that writer role; any retirement or cutover must be handled as a separate owning task.
RH3 is HTTP Hosted validation only. Browser/Playwright interaction remains a separate Browser/UI stage and is not required to reopen or extend this completed Hosted implementation.

nonScope: No semantic, canonical, relation, ConfigData, localization, frontend, or asset data is changed by the RH3 freeze.
No Browser/UI or Playwright runtime dependency is added to Route/Hosted QA.
No GitHub Pages deployment, gh-pages mutation, force-push, repository writer, Status Source writer, or Project Status writer is introduced.
No OLD Route/Hosted QA runtime, workflow, package alias, or historical evidence is made authoritative for NEW RH3 execution.
No validator is disabled, bypassed, exception-routed, or converted to a false PASS to achieve completion.
nextStart: Run required project-check on the RH3 freeze commit. If self-test, changed-path planning, and owning-validator execution all PASS, classify RH3 as COMPLETE. Reopen RH3 only under the explicit reopen conditions below.
reopenConditions: RH0, RH1, or RH2 predecessor contracts no longer satisfy their frozen completion requirements.
The authoritative hosted target, repository base, public routes, detail fixtures, negative fixture, hosted check IDs, or source-SHA strategy changes.
The route-hosted-qa owner no longer resolves RH3 paths exclusively to the dedicated route-hosted-qa-self-test validator.
Authoritative evidence shows the NEW runtime imports or executes Playwright/browser automation, mutates repository or deployment state, or depends on OLD Project Doctor runtime.
A current-branch-only Project Check failure is causally owned by RH3 implementation or this RH3 checkpoint path.
Hosted, Browser/UI, semantic, frontend, asset, or deployment-writer ownership boundaries change.
